WFP price per kg against Comext

COMEXT rows with a Comext kg/unit, EUR per kg, log scales. Outside the shaded 0.2-5x band is flagged. Click a point to open the row.

Where the estimated weight sits

Total estimated tonnes by item, top 12. A bar that looks too long is the first place to look.

Consistency checks

Integrity checks test the outputs against the toolkit's own rules and must be zero. Review checks point at rows to look at. Select a check to see its rows.

Consistency within items

One row per item. A wide range of price per kg inside one item means some rows have the wrong quantity unit, the wrong weight, or belong to another item. Select an item to see its rows.
